cues.speaker: NEWS
cues.text: Good morning, Nexus City. Overnight, residents reported unusual lights over the harbor.
cues.camera: Slow dolly from city window toward bedside; warm light.

cues.speaker: PLAYER
cues.text: Another ordinary morning. That would be nice.
cues.camera: Slow dolly from city window toward bedside; warm light.

cues.speaker: NEWS
cues.text: Officials say there is no cause for alarm—
cues.camera: Slow dolly from city window toward bedside; warm light.

cues.speaker: PLAYER
cues.text: The windows are shaking.
cues.camera: Handheld push-in to trembling glass; violet rift reflected.

cues.speaker: NOVA
cues.text: Neural resonance confirmed. Can you hear me?
cues.camera: Handheld push-in to trembling glass; violet rift reflected.

cues.speaker: PLAYER
cues.text: Who is this?
cues.camera: Handheld push-in to trembling glass; violet rift reflected.

cues.speaker: NOVA
cues.text: NOVA. Your building is destabilizing. Leave the apartment now.
cues.camera: Handheld push-in to trembling glass; violet rift reflected.

cues.speaker: PLAYER
cues.text: What happened to the sky?
cues.camera: Handheld push-in to trembling glass; violet rift reflected.

cues.speaker: NOVA
cues.text: A Fracture. Reality is intersecting with something it was never meant to touch.
cues.camera: Handheld push-in to trembling glass; violet rift reflected.

cues.speaker: PLAYER
cues.text: There are people trapped in the hall.
cues.camera: Tight over-shoulder; HUD light crosses player face.

cues.speaker: NOVA
cues.text: Then we help them. Move. I will guide you.
cues.camera: Tight over-shoulder; HUD light crosses player face.

cues.speaker: CIVILIAN
cues.text: Please! The stairwell is blocked!
cues.camera: Tracking shot; debris in foreground; player remains controllable.

cues.speaker: PLAYER
cues.text: Get behind me. I think I can move this.
cues.camera: Tracking shot; debris in foreground; player remains controllable.

cues.speaker: NOVA
cues.text: That energy came from you. We will understand it later.
cues.camera: Tracking shot; debris in foreground; player remains controllable.

cues.speaker: PLAYER
cues.text: Later sounds good. Where is the exit?
cues.camera: Tracking shot; debris in foreground; player remains controllable.

cues.speaker: CIVILIAN
cues.text: My daughter is on the other side of that door!
cues.camera: Low angle on fallen beam; cut to trapped family.

cues.speaker: PLAYER
cues.text: Stay low. I am getting her out.
cues.camera: Low angle on fallen beam; cut to trapped family.

cues.speaker: NOVA
cues.text: Structural failure in twenty seconds. The support beam is shifting.
cues.camera: Low angle on fallen beam; cut to trapped family.

cues.speaker: PLAYER
cues.text: I can feel something in my hands.
cues.camera: Extreme close-up of hands; particles spiral around beam.

cues.speaker: NOVA
cues.text: Focus on the beam. Do not fight the current; redirect it.
cues.camera: Extreme close-up of hands; particles spiral around beam.

cues.speaker: PLAYER
cues.text: Everybody back!
cues.camera: Extreme close-up of hands; particles spiral around beam.

cues.speaker: CHILD
cues.text: Mom?
cues.camera: Wide reveal; player clears passage; survivor runs past.

cues.speaker: CIVILIAN
cues.text: Thank you. I thought we were gone.
cues.camera: Wide reveal; player clears passage; survivor runs past.

cues.speaker: PLAYER
cues.text: Take the service stairs. Do not stop.
cues.camera: Wide reveal; player clears passage; survivor runs past.

cues.speaker: NOVA
cues.text: You used a Fracture ability without an Operator interface. That should be impossible.
cues.camera: Two-shot framing player against shifting geometry.

cues.speaker: PLAYER
cues.text: Then stop telling me what should be possible.
cues.camera: Two-shot framing player against shifting geometry.

cues.speaker: RADIO
cues.text: Emergency services are asking residents to shelter indoors.
cues.camera: Crane reveal of damaged streets; no loading-screen training.

cues.speaker: PLAYER
cues.text: That advice is a little late.
cues.camera: Crane reveal of damaged streets; no loading-screen training.

cues.speaker: NOVA
cues.text: Three safe routes. Two are already changing.
cues.camera: Crane reveal of damaged streets; no loading-screen training.

cues.speaker: PLAYER
cues.text: Changing how?
cues.camera: Camera tracks a road bending into unfamiliar terrain.

cues.speaker: NOVA
cues.text: The road ahead now connects to a place that did not exist this morning.
cues.camera: Camera tracks a road bending into unfamiliar terrain.

cues.speaker: SURVIVOR
cues.text: Those things came out of the purple light!
cues.camera: Gameplay camera takes over; brief close-ups on survivor.

cues.speaker: PLAYER
cues.text: Get to the transit station. I will hold them off.
cues.camera: Gameplay camera takes over; brief close-ups on survivor.

cues.speaker: NOVA
cues.text: Remember: cover, movement, then ability. Survive first.
cues.camera: Gameplay camera takes over; brief close-ups on survivor.

cues.speaker: PLAYER
cues.text: And if the street tears open again?
cues.camera: Wide street shot; rift pulses; cut back to player control.

cues.speaker: NOVA
cues.text: Then we improvise.
cues.camera: Wide street shot; rift pulses; cut back to player control.

cues.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
cues.text: Weapon down. State your affiliation.
cues.camera: Handheld street-level track from broken barricade to Vale; weapon held low

cues.speaker: PLAYER
cues.text: I woke up in an apartment. Is that an affiliation?
cues.camera: Handheld street-level track from broken barricade to Vale; weapon held low

cues.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
cues.text: Not if you can explain how you survived the breach.
cues.camera: Handheld street-level track from broken barricade to Vale; weapon held low

cues.speaker: NOVA
cues.text: Recommend honesty, selectively.
cues.camera: Tight over-shoulder to player, then cut to Vale reaction; NOVA remains noncorporeal

cues.speaker: PLAYER
cues.text: I can hear a voice. It says its name is NOVA.
cues.camera: Tight over-shoulder to player, then cut to Vale reaction; NOVA remains noncorporeal

cues.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
cues.text: That is not possible. NOVA was decommissioned.
cues.camera: Tight over-shoulder to player, then cut to Vale reaction; NOVA remains noncorporeal

cues.speaker: NOVA
cues.text: That is an inaccurate description of events.
cues.camera: Tight over-shoulder to player, then cut to Vale reaction; NOVA remains noncorporeal

cues.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
cues.text: Come with us. We can keep civilians safe.
cues.camera: Wide shot through gate to civilian aid line; hold on player choice

cues.speaker: PLAYER
cues.text: I will come. But I decide who I help.
cues.camera: Wide shot through gate to civilian aid line; hold on player choice

cues.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
cues.text: We need people who can withstand the Fractures.
cues.camera: Slow orbit around map table; preserve player custom appearance

cues.speaker: PLAYER
cues.text: You need soldiers. I am not one.
cues.camera: Slow orbit around map table; preserve player custom appearance

cues.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
cues.text: Then be something better. Make your own choice.
cues.camera: Slow orbit around map table; preserve player custom appearance

cues.speaker: NOVA
cues.text: There are benefits to cooperating. There are also risks.
cues.camera: Slow orbit around map table; preserve player custom appearance

cues.speaker: PLAYER
cues.text: I am not signing away my life because the sky cracked.
cues.camera: Two-shot; focus rack from civilian queue to Vale

cues.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
cues.text: Fair. Prove you can protect this district, and we talk again.
cues.camera: Two-shot; focus rack from civilian queue to Vale

cues.speaker: PLAYER
cues.text: I will work with your team, but civilians come first.
cues.camera: Medium close-ups; neutral, respectful eyelines

cues.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
cues.text: Agreed. You answer to your conscience before you answer to me.
cues.camera: Medium close-ups; neutral, respectful eyelines

cues.speaker: PLAYER
cues.text: I will help, but I am not joining your command.
cues.camera: Medium close-ups; Vale steps aside to let player pass

cues.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
cues.text: Then prove that independence is not indifference.
cues.camera: Medium close-ups; Vale steps aside to let player pass

cues.speaker: NOVA
cues.text: Verdant Forest. The vegetation has absorbed Fracture energy.
cues.camera: Aerial descent to walking-height tracking shot; forest canopy moves naturally

cues.speaker: PLAYER
cues.text: It looks peaceful.
cues.camera: Aerial descent to walking-height tracking shot; forest canopy moves naturally

cues.speaker: SCOUT MIRA
cues.text: That is how it catches you off guard.
cues.camera: Aerial descent to walking-height tracking shot; forest canopy moves naturally

cues.speaker: PLAYER
cues.text: You have been out here alone?
cues.camera: Three-shot; Mira remains wary, not hostile

cues.speaker: SCOUT MIRA
cues.text: Long enough to learn that the forest remembers footsteps.
cues.camera: Three-shot; Mira remains wary, not hostile

cues.speaker: NOVA
cues.text: Anomalous signal beneath the roots.
cues.camera: Low-angle macro on luminous roots; return to player eye level

cues.speaker: SCOUT MIRA
cues.text: Do not call every secret a target. Some deserve to stay hidden.
cues.camera: Low-angle macro on luminous roots; return to player eye level

cues.speaker: PLAYER
cues.text: We will look. We will not destroy what we do not understand.
cues.camera: Low-angle macro on luminous roots; return to player eye level
